title.value: The WhatsApp Template edit page's Body Text preview panel live-counts characters and substitutes {{N}} placeholders

description.value: Closes SCENARIOS.md §15's Body Text preview gap - whatsapp-template-body-preview.js's own charCount()/renderPreview()/update() are already unit-tested (BodyPreviewTest, JS whatsapp-template-body-preview.test.js), but nothing before this proved the real, delegated 'input' listener actually reaches a real <textarea name='body_text'> rendered by the real Magento_Ui form component, or that the real DOM panel (data-body-preview-count/data-body-preview-text, from view/adminhtml/templates/whatsapptemplate/bodypreview.phtml) actually updates in response. A real, exact-length body ('Hi {{1}}, your order {{2}} shipped', 34 characters) is typed via a real fillField (which fires real per-character input events, unlike a value set programmatically) - the counter must read '34 / 1024 characters' (BodyPreview::BODY_MAX_LENGTH) and the preview panel must show both {{N}} placeholders substituted with their own distinct sample-value text, proof the real regex substitution ran against this real input, not a stale/default render.

see.userInput: Hi [Sample value 1], your order [Sample value 2] shipped
